_comment: Change 'active_provider' to swap the entire backend without touching pipeline code. Each provider block only names ENV VAR KEYS, never actual secrets.

supabase_postgres.notes: Connect via Supabase's Supavisor pooler (transaction mode), using a dedicated read-only Postgres role. NEVER point this at the service_role key.

generic_postgres.notes: Same postgres.py adapter as Supabase — any vanilla Postgres warehouse works with just a connection string swap.

snowflake.notes: Original spec target. Kept as a working reference — see lib/db/providers/snowflake.py.

mysql_warehouse.notes: Illustrative third provider — demonstrates the adapter interface isn't Postgres-specific.
